item.title: Calls for Under-16 Social Media Ban Begins as Madras HC Appeals to Centre
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Madras High Court has urged the central government to examine the possibility of enacting a law similar to recent Australian legislation that prohibits children below the age of 16 from accessing social media platforms. The observation was made while disposing of a petition concerning the easy availability of pornographic content on the internet. item.title: Northeast's Largest Auditorium to Be Inaugurated in Guwahati on December 29
item.description: GUWAHATI: Union Home Minister Amit Shah will inaugurate the Jyoti Bishnu Prekhyagriha in Guwahati on Monday, December 29, during his upcoming visit to the city. This will become the largest auditorium in the Northeast region. item.title: Vaibhav Suryavanshi Among 20 Young Achievers Honoured with Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar
item.description: GUWAHATI: Fourteen-year-old cricketer Vaibhav Suryavanshi was conferred along with 19 young achievers the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar on Friday, December 26, at Rashtrapati Bhavan in New Delhi. The award was presented by President Droupadi Murmu, recognising Suryavanshi’s achievements in the sport. item.title: Freelance Journalist Found Dead at Residence in Aizawl
item.description: GUWAHATI: A freelance journalist was found dead at her residence in Aizawl on Thursday, December 25, 2025, police said. The deceased has been identified as Ezrela Dalidia Fanai (41), who had worked with several national media houses over the years. item.title: Herbal ‘Teas’ Aren’t Tea, Only Products Made From Camellia Sinensis Are, Says FSSAI
